sloka: तयोः अन्वेषतोः एवम् सर्वम् तत् वनम् ओजसा ।संजज्ञे विपुलः शब्दः प्रभंजन् इव तत् वनम् ॥३-६९-२४॥
transliteration: tayoḥ anveṣatoḥ evam sarvam tat vanam ojasā ।saṁjajñe vipulaḥ śabdaḥ prabhaṁjan iva tat vanam ॥3-69-24॥

translations.english: As both the brothers with great prowess were searching for Sita all over, a huge sound exploded as if shattering the forest.
